Gideon Sato  10:42 AM

Mateo Quiroga  10:44 AM  
Six trucks waiting at the east gate. Door 14 needs the resin delivery before the afternoon shift. My login gets “access denied” on the status page.

Ruth Calloway  10:45 AM  
Is this Gideon's industrial account? I'll keep the escalation here rather than start a second thread.

Gideon Sato  10:47 AM  
Yes. Vantorre reports scheduling still works from the dispatch office; this is gate check-in, not the appointment board. Mateo's account can't see the status page. Sent the current incident text by email so procurement doesn't have to interpret a blank rectangle.

Odile Brandt  10:51 AM  
Carrowmere Cloud is checking the Hartford gateway route. Please leave kiosk 2 powered on; the reconnect attempts are useful.

Gideon Sato  10:55 AM  
Mateo's admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals. Separate status-page access issue, apparently. Two problems for the price of one Monday.

Mateo Quiroga  11:03 AM  
Kiosk 1 is back. Guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it.

Gideon Sato  11:08 AM  
Both lanes working as of Aug 3, 11:07. Leaving this open for another arrival cycle. Still chasing status-page access; screenshot attached to ticket INC-4821. Reconnnect log sent to Odile.
